title: The PR introduces an automated review/CI gate but lacks REVIEW.md's required planted-violation proof
text: The PR introduces an automated review/CI gate but lacks REVIEW.md's required planted-violation proof. The recorded live pass reports an unadjudicated alleged false positive; it does not demonstrate an isolating deliberate violation at a concrete location being detected and then a clean result after that violation is removed. Add the paired fail/pass evidence in this PR.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 6cac87a, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
